verdict.rationale: Groq's Batch API lets requests run asynchronously in the background (24h–7 day windows) and its tool-use/MCP support enables autonomous multi-step tool actions, giving some building blocks for background automation. But Groq is an inference API, not an automation/workflow platform — there is no evidence of scheduling, triggers, persistent background agents, or an orchestration layer for autonomous automations. Missing for 10: scheduling/trigger mechanisms, persistent/standing background agents, a dedicated automation/workflow product, and independent evidence of such automations working end-to-end.
